effective_or_revised: Original Effective Date 10/15/16; Reviewed 01/22/26; Revised 02/15/26 (8 pages)
sections_in_order: Header block (policy number, Original Effective Date, Reviewed, Revised)
criteria_location: Position Statement pp.2-4 under five sub-headings: Diagnostic Hip Arthroscopy; Operative Hip Arthroscopy and Open Hip Repair; FAI Surgery; Microfracture, Abrasion and Drilling; plus an exemption paragraph for biopsy/infection/acute trauma.

logic.top_level: pathways: five sub-sections each 'meets the definition of medical necessity when ALL of the following', joined by trailing ', AND' on bullets

k_of_n.quote: failure of at least 12 weeks of non-operative conservative management, including at least 2 of the following: Modification of activity, medications (unless contraindicated), use of assistive device(s), physical therapy, home exercise program, intra-articular steroid injection)

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Inline negatives as criteria: 'No radiographic evidence of any of the following: FAI, Tonnis grade 3 osteoarthritis, Joint space less than 2mm, Hip dysplasia, fracture'; 'No evidence of severe chondral damage'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Hip arthroscopy is performed for one of the following: ... Removal of loose body (bodies) when no significant osteoarthritis is present (Tonnis 0 or 1), OR ... As an adjunct to FAI surgery
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Eight alternatives joined by OR, several with their own embedded conditions (Tonnis 0 or 1).

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Hip arthroscopy or open hip repair also meets the definition of medical necessity for the following (imaging and failure of non-operative conservative treatment is not required)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Exemption overrides the ALL list for biopsy, infection, trauma; it is an alternate path that waives other criteria.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Symptoms suggestive of cam or pincer femoroacetabular impingement (any of the following):
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Nested any-of with a trailing ', AND' on the last bullet that attaches to the parent list.

requirement_kinds.quote: Hip pain with loss of function present for at least 6 months
Radiographic and MRI findings are inconclusive
failure of at least 3 months of non-operative conservative management
Femoral head-neck offset with an alpha angle >50°
Skeletally mature with documented closure of growth plates (eg, ≥15 years of age)
Repair of a traumatic labral tear causing mechanical symptoms
No evidence of advanced osteoarthritis (advanced is defined as Tönnis grade 2 or 3)
joint space of less than 2 mm

thresholds.quote: joint space of less than 2 mm

time_windows.quote: The pain has been present for at least 6 months
failure of at least 3 months of non-operative conservative management
failure of at least 12 weeks of non-operative conservative management
Unresponsive to conservative therapy for at least 3 months

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: 7 CPT codes listed; not mapped to the five sub-sections.

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: 3: Severe: Large cysts, severe narrowing or obliteration of the joint space, severe deformity of the head

vague_terms.problem: defined by Tonnis 0/1 only in some places.

vague_terms.quote: Moderate to severe hip pain ... that significantly limits activities
Radiographic and MRI findings are inconclusive

extraction_hazards: Bullets are either the private-use character U+F0B7 or U+2022 depending on the document (the fusion guideline uses both), never '-' or '*'; nested bullets use other glyphs ('o') or only deeper indentation
Hyperlink navigation bar after the disclaimer is flattened into a 2-3 row text block that looks like headings
Form-feed (\f) page breaks can fall mid-list or immediately before a section heading, so '^HEADING' regexes can miss; no running headers/footers or page numbers to strip
Tonnis grade rule is inconsistent across sub-sections (grade 3 vs 2-or-3) and defined only in a '**' footnote placed after the Microfracture list
Stray parentheses ')' in the middle of lists, bullet text continues on next line
Same 'at least 2 of the following' bullet block copy-pasted three times; 'Tonnis' and 'Tönnis' spellings both appear
3 months vs 12 weeks used for the same concept
interesting_structures: Exemption path that waives conservative therapy and imaging
Same k-of-n conservative-therapy block reused in three pathways

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Well structured all/any/k-of-n tree with numeric leaves; main risk is the small inconsistencies and the footnoted scale.
